# Harkness Training Solutions

> Harkness Training Solutions (HTS) helps leaders, especially new managers, rehearse hard conversations before they are real. Mishandled conversations cost teams trust, talent, and time. People learn a simple storytelling framework, practice with an improv actor who pushes back, and hear from peers how it landed.

Many participants are new managers at hard-tech companies in the South Bay of Los Angeles (space, defense, and aerospace). The practice is for leaders, not only engineers. Sessions run online and in El Segundo, California. Contact: hello@harknesstraining.com, (310) 896-5379, 222 N. Pacific Coast Hwy, El Segundo, CA.

Founding rates lock in for teams that start by Dec 31, 2026. Teams of 15 to 20 people get 10% off the Kickoff, Pilot, and Full Program. Over 20 people, ask for a cohort quote. That team rate does not apply to Practice Lab. The live list of the next Open Labs is on the Open Lab page.

## Offers

- [Open Lab](https://harknesstraining.com/open-lab): Free, 90 minutes. Bring one conversation you are dreading, or watch. Every session is online at 12:00–1:30 PM Pacific. Once a month there is also an in-person session in El Segundo at 6:00–7:30 PM Pacific.
- [Demo](https://harknesstraining.com/demo): Free, 20 minutes, for teams.
- [Kickoff](https://harknesstraining.com/#programs): $150 per person. One 75-minute session. Credited in full toward the Pilot.
- [Pilot](https://harknesstraining.com/#programs): $650 per person. Three sessions, weeks 1–3.
- [Full Program](https://harknesstraining.com/#programs): $2,500 per person. Five sessions, with a before-and-after results report.
- [Practice Lab](https://harknesstraining.com/#programs): $395 per person per month. Two sessions a month.
- [Custom programs](https://harknesstraining.com/custom): Quoted. Scenarios written from the conversations a team's leaders keep facing.
